graph_scope: all directed loop-free labelled graphs on n=1..4; no resource or state pruning
partitions: all set partitions via restricted growth words; quotient loops retained
distance_scope: every concrete start and every saturated target including empty/full; local-lifting equalities and optimistic inequalities
route_scope: n<=3 every quotient walk of lengths0..4 and every actual target subset; compare raw word trees to forward/backward representative sets
